12-Day Greece Tour: Athens, Mykonos, Santorini & Crete
summary:
The 12-Day Athens, Mykonos, Santorini & Crete Tour moves from the Greek capital through the Cyclades before finishing on the country’s largest island. Start in Athens with the Acropolis and historic center, then continue to Mykonos for its beaches and lively towns, followed by Santorini and its volcanic caldera. Crete adds another dimension, with a deeper local history, distinctive cuisine and a landscape that feels quite different from the Cycladic islands.
The journey is scheduled between April and October to suit seasonal connections. Included are selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, one domestic flight, speed ferry tickets, airport and port transfers, and scheduled sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Half day Morning Athens City tour
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a half-day guided tour of Athens, including the Acropolis of Athens, Acropolis Museum, and Parthenon. Continue past the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. Afternoon at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Mykonos
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel.
Transfer to the port for your Seajet ferry to Mykonos.
Arrival and transfer to your hotel. Rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Mykonos.
Optional:Domestic flights to Mykonos are available upon request.

itinerary.title: Free day in Mykonos
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Free day in Mykonos.
Relax on the island’s beautiful beaches or explore Mykonos Town.
Optional visit to Delos, one of Greece’s most important archaeological islands.
Enjoy Mykonos’ famous nightlife in the evening. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Free day in Mykonos
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day in Mykonos.
Relax on the beaches, explore Mykonos Town, or visit nearby Delos.
In the evening, experience the island’s famous nightlife. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel. Transfer to the port for your ferry to Santorini.
Arrival and transfer to your hotel. Rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Free in Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Free day in Santorini.
Relax on the island’s famous black, red, or golden sand beaches.
Explore Fira or join optional boat and volcano excursions available on the island.
Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Free in Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Free day in Santorini.
Explore the villages of Fira and Oia. Enjoy scenic views, local shops, and cliffside cafes.
Relax on Santorini’s famous black, red, and golden sand beaches.
Optional tours and excursions are available upon request.
Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Heraklion (Crete)
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel. Transfer to the port for your ferry to Crete.
Arrival and transfer to your hotel. Rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Crete.

itinerary.title: Free day in Heraklion
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a free day in Heraklion, the capital of Crete. We recommend visiting the famous Palace of Knossos and the Heraklion Archaeological Museum. You may also explore the city’s local cafés, shops, and seaside promenade. Overnight in Heraklion.

itinerary.title: Flight to Athens
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel. Free time at leisure until transfer to the airport for your domestic flight to Athens.
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Departure from Athens
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Athens Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 12-Day Greece Island & Athens Tour?
faqs.a: The 12-Day Greece Island & Athens Tour covers Athens, Mykonos, Crete, and Santorini. You will explore Athens' ancient landmarks, enjoy the cosmopolitan atmosphere of Mykonos, discover the rich history and diverse landscapes of Crete, and experience Santorini's world-famous sunsets and caldera views. The tour runs for 11 nights and 12 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 12-Day Greece Island & Athens Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,495 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, domestic speed ferry tickets, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and port transfers specified in the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: Are ferry tickets included in this Greece island-hopping itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, all required domestic speed ferry tickets between Athens, Mykonos, Crete, and Santorini are included. These ferry journeys offer a comfortable and scenic way to travel between some of Greece's most popular islands.

faqs.q: Are international flights included in the package?
faqs.a: No, international flights are not included in the tour price. Travelers are responsible for arranging their own flights to and from Greece. Magnificent Travel can assist with travel planning and recommendations if needed.

faqs.q: Does the 12-day Greece Island & Athens Tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise while helping you discover Greece's most famous destinations.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors seeking a combination of ancient history, island culture, beautiful beaches, and spectacular scenery. It offers an excellent introduction to both mainland Greece and the Greek islands.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, island villages, ferry ports, and historic districts. Most travelers in average health can comfortably participate in the itinerary.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Mykonos, Crete, and Santorini?
faqs.a: Mykonos is famous for its whitewashed streets, beaches, windmills, and lively atmosphere. Crete offers fascinating archaeological sites, traditional villages, beautiful beaches, and authentic Greek culture. Santorini is renowned for its dramatic caldera views, blue-domed churches, volcanic landscapes, and unforgettable sunsets.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Greece Island & Athens Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, ferry conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 12-Day Greece Island & Athens Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The tour operates throughout the year, subject to seasonal ferry schedules. You can extend your stay in Athens, Mykonos, Crete, or Santorini, upgrade hotel categories, add optional excursions, or modify the itinerary according to your preferences. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
